svg.metadata: {"id": "s101", "name": "金秋山林·护林防火", "cat": "季节专题", "tags": ["安全", "森林防火", "秋游", "秋天"], "desc": "层林尽染的金秋山林：远山、满山金黄橙红的树、蜿蜒山路、木制防火瞭望塔、禁火标牌、飘落的黄叶，秋季防火主题的记忆点。", "stand": {"ground_y": 880, "x": [520, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": 0}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.15, "loop": "drift", "depth": 0.05}, {"name": "mountains", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": 0.15}, {"name": "forest_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": 0.3}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": 0.6}, {"name": "trees_mid", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": 0.62}, {"name": "tower", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": 0.55}, {"name": "flag", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "sway", "depth": 0.55}, {"name": "sign", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": null, "depth": 0.8}, {"name": "near", "enter": "rise", "delay": 1.0, "loop": null, "depth": 1}, {"name": "falling", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "fall", "depth": 0.9}], "palette": {"sky1": "#8CC8EC", "sky2": "#FFE7C2", "sun": "#FFF0C4", "mtn": "#C9B8D6", "mtn2": "#B49CC4", "far": "#F0B65A", "far2": "#E59B45", "mid": "#E9A43F", "ground": "#E8C27A", "ground2": "#D8A85E", "path": "#F6E2B5", "t1": "#F6B930", "t2": "#FFD95A", "t3": "#E07A22", "t4": "#D9542B", "trunk": "#7A4E33", "trunk2": "#5E3A26", "wood": "#A5683F", "wood2": "#7F4C2C", "roof": "#C4452F", "board": "#F9F3E3", "red": "#E2382F", "fl": "#F2622E", "fl2": "#FFB238", "grass": "#C9923F"}}
